description: Is my trade sound against the live board? Your own trade, held against the desk's principles before it is placed: a named stop below the entry, the stop distance, the name's entry state, a report inside the hold and the market gate. The same check on the live board, with the Coil Live rulebook applied to the trade: the position size the stop buys at the rulebook's risk per position, its one-name cap, the entry guards and, when the rulebook states them, the maximum loss and the session-low chase guard. Optional day_low (the broker's session low) applies the session-low guard and optional equity turns the size into shares. dip: {ok, codes, setup}: present only for oversold-pullback candidates; a dip buy only on a completed hourly turn above the entry-quality and depth floors. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.

day_low.description: Optional. The session low at the broker, e.g. 52.80

equity.description: Optional. Account equity in dollars, to size in shares, e.g. 25000

stop.description: The stop price: the level at which the trade is wrong, below the entry, e.g. 51.50

name: check_my_trade_live
